_comment: A vocabulary line's grammar, as cases both renderers must agree on: lib/texparse.py parse_voc, voc_text and lib/tex2html.py render_voc (the reader and the PDF read the macros this way) and lib/vocline.js, which a video's player draws a macro line with. `runs` is what parse reads, `html` what render draws, `text` what flatten gives back, `macro` whether the line is a macro line (lib/chunkdiv.py is_macro_line, ParsehVocline.isMacro); a line that cannot be read has `error` instead, compared by CODE -- `groups` for a macro short of its braces, `unclosed` for a brace never closed -- because Python raises three kinds of error for the two. `lang` is a registry code: a \vb prints that language's two labels, and its words are isolated with its code and direction. Run by tests/test_vocline.py.

cases._why: a plain line: no macro, nothing isolated, nothing changed
cases.html: buongiorno good morning (buon + giorno, day)
cases.text: buongiorno good morning (buon + giorno, day)

cases._why: a plain right-to-left line is text to this renderer
cases.html: سلام salām hello (peace)
cases.text: سلام salām hello (peace)

cases._why: the middle dot of a plain line is only a character here
cases.voc: volere to want · vorrei I would like (conditional)
runs: volere to want · vorrei I would like (conditional)
cases.html: volere to want · vorrei I would like (conditional)
cases.text: volere to want · vorrei I would like (conditional)

cases._why: html.escape(quote=True): & < > " and '
cases.html: c'è there is & "here" <b> 100%
cases.text: c'è there is & "here" <b> 100%

cases._why: an empty line
a blank line is nothing

cases.voc: haben · pret. hatte · p.p. gehabt · to have (er hat)
runs: haben · pret. hatte · p.p. gehabt · to have (er hat)
cases.html: haben · pret. hatte · p.p. gehabt · to have (er hat)
cases.text: haben · pret. hatte · p.p. gehabt · to have (er hat)

cases._why: whitespace is collapsed the way Python's \s collapses it: a newline, a no-break space and an ideographic space are spaces
cases.html: a b c d e
cases.text: a b c d e

cases._why: Python's \s takes U+001C-1F and U+0085 for spaces and does not take U+FEFF; JavaScript's takes the opposite
cases.html: a b c﻿d
cases.text: a b c﻿d

cases._why: ~ and -- are only text to parse and render; flatten reads them as the PDF does
cases.html: a~b -- c --- d
cases.text: a b – c — d

cases._why: \nobreak alone is not an entry: not a macro line, and parse drops it
cases.html: a b
cases.text: a b

cases._why: a space before the brace is not \dw{ : by the rule a plain line, though parse still reads it
cases.html: a b c
cases.text: a b c

cases._why: a word, its romanisation, what it means: a real space between the two
cases.html: کتاب ketāb book
cases.text: کتاب ketāb book

cases._why: entries parted by a semicolon
cases.html: کتاب ketāb book; قلم qalam pen
cases.text: کتاب ketāb book; قلم qalam pen

cases._why: Japanese with its romanisation
cases.voc: \dw{昔}{mukashi} long ago, the old days; said twice to open a tale
runs: long ago, the old days; said twice to open a tale
cases.html: 昔 mukashi long ago, the old days; said twice to open a tale
cases.text: 昔 mukashi long ago, the old days; said twice to open a tale

cases._why: Japanese with its reading in the romanisation slot
cases.html: 皆さん みなさん everyone (polite)
cases.text: 皆さん みなさん everyone (polite)

cases._why: a character outside the basic plane
cases.html: 𠮷 jí a rare variant of 吉
cases.text: 𠮷 jí a rare variant of 吉

cases._why: a zero-width non-joiner inside a word is not a space
cases.html: می‌کنم mi-konam I do
cases.text: می‌کنم mi-konam I do

cases._why: an apostrophe is escaped as ', an empty romanisation prints nothing
cases.html: <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">l'uomo</bdi> man; <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">c'è</bdi> there is
cases.text: l'uomo man; c'è there is

cases._why: whitespace between the groups is skipped
cases.html: a b c
cases.text: a b c

cases._why: both labels: pres. and past
cases.html: دیدن didan · pres. بین bin · past دید did · to see
cases.text: دیدن didan · pres. بین bin · past دید did · to see

cases._why: Arabic's own labels: impf. and masdar
cases.html: خَرَجَ ḫaraja (I) · impf. يَخْرُجُ yaḫruju · masdar خُرُوج ḫurūj · to go out
cases.text: خَرَجَ ḫaraja (I) · impf. يَخْرُجُ yaḫruju · masdar خُرُوج ḫurūj · to go out

cases._why: a verb with no masdar in use leaves the third pair out
cases.html: خَرَجَ ḫaraja (I) · impf. يَخْرُجُ yaḫruju · to go out
cases.text: خَرَجَ ḫaraja (I) · impf. يَخْرُجُ yaḫruju · to go out

cases._why: a \pw inside a meaning
cases.html: <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">andare</bdi> · pres. <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">vado</bdi> · p.p. <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">andato</bdi> · to go (aux. <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">essere</bdi>)
cases.text: andare · pres. vado · p.p. andato · to go (aux. essere)

cases._why: a slash beside a macro: avere/essere, not avere / essere
cases.html: <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">finire</bdi> · pres. <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">finisco</bdi> · p.p. <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">finito</bdi> · to finish (aux. <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">avere</bdi>/<bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">essere</bdi>)
cases.text: finire · pres. finisco · p.p. finito · to finish (aux. avere/essere)

cases._why: a sound on the first form only
cases.html: prendere prèndere · pres. prendo · p.p. preso · to take (p.r. presi)
cases.text: prendere prèndere · pres. prendo · p.p. preso · to take (p.r. presi)

cases._why: a blank pair loses its label with it: split, and no can't
cases.html: 睡觉 shuìjiào · split 睡了觉 shuìle jiào · to sleep
cases.text: 睡觉 shuìjiào · split 睡了觉 shuìle jiào · to sleep

cases._why: the second pair blank and the third kept; then the chunk's own form, named as the books name it
cases.voc: \vb{看见}{kànjiàn}{}{}{看不见}{kànbujiàn}{to see}; here \pw{看得见} \textit{kàndejiàn}, can see
cases.html: 看见 kànjiàn · can't 看不见 kànbujiàn · to see; here 看得见 kàndejiàn, can see
cases.text: 看见 kànjiàn · can't 看不见 kànbujiàn · to see; here 看得见 kàndejiàn, can see

cases._why: Japanese's labels: stem and -te
cases.html: 書く kaku · stem 書き kaki · -te 書いて kaite · to write
cases.text: 書く kaku · stem 書き kaki · -te 書いて kaite · to write

cases._why: no sound in any slot still prints every pair; a \textit inside the meaning
cases.voc: \vb{yağmak}{}{yağıyor}{}{yağar}{}{to fall, of rain; \textit{yağ-ar-dı} fall + aorist + past}
cases.html: yağmak · pres. yağıyor · aor. yağar · to fall, of rain; yağ-ar-dı fall + aorist + past
cases.text: yağmak · pres. yağıyor · aor. yağar · to fall, of rain; yağ-ar-dı fall + aorist + past

cases._why: the chunk's form named after the entry
cases.voc: \vb{wind}{waɪnd}{wound}{waʊnd}{wound}{waʊnd}{to turn a key}; here \pw{wound} \textit{waʊnd}, not the noun
cases.html: wind waɪnd · past wound waʊnd · p.p. wound waʊnd · to turn a key; here wound waʊnd, not the noun
cases.text: wind waɪnd · past wound waʊnd · p.p. wound waʊnd · to turn a key; here wound waʊnd, not the noun

cases._why: German's labels: pret. and p.p.
cases.html: <bdi lang="de" dir="ltr" class="v">gehen</bdi> · pret. <bdi lang="de" dir="ltr" class="v">ging</bdi> · p.p. <bdi lang="de" dir="ltr" class="v">gegangen</bdi> · to go
cases.text: gehen · pret. ging · p.p. gegangen · to go

cases._why: a compound: the light verb's \vb with an empty meaning, the \bw run straight onto it
cases.html: avoir avwar · pres. ai é · p.p. eu ü · peur peur ‘to be afraid’
cases.text: avoir avwar · pres. ai é · p.p. eu ü · peur peur ‘to be afraid’

cases._why: the same in Persian, right to left
cases.html: زدن zadan · pres. زن zan · past زد zad · لبخند labxand ‘to smile’
cases.text: زدن zadan · pres. زن zan · past زد zad · لبخند labxand ‘to smile’

cases._why: Hindi's compound, a parenthesis opening the meaning
cases.html: करना karnā · stem कर kar · perf. किया kiyā · (+ ने) · काम kām ‘m. work’; रहा था was, the continuous
cases.text: करना karnā · stem कर kar · perf. किया kiyā · (+ ने) · काम kām ‘m. work’; रहा था was, the continuous

cases._why: Spanish's labels: pres. and pret.
cases.html: <bdi lang="es" dir="ltr" class="v">tener</bdi> · pres. <bdi lang="es" dir="ltr" class="v">tengo</bdi> · pret. <bdi lang="es" dir="ltr" class="v">tuvo</bdi> · to have
cases.text: tener · pres. tengo · pret. tuvo · to have

cases._why: Catalan's labels, pres. and p.p., and a sound only where the spelling hides an open e (docs/lang/ca.md)
cases.html: perdre pèrdre · pres. perdo pèrdu · p.p. perdut · to lose
cases.text: perdre pèrdre · pres. perdo pèrdu · p.p. perdut · to lose

cases._why: every pair and the meaning blank: the verb alone
cases.html: <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi>
cases.text: a

cases._why: a form of spaces is blank, and its sound goes with it
cases.html: a b · m
cases.text: a b · m

cases._why: macros nested in the meaning
cases.html: a b · past c d · p.p. e f · a (x y; z)
cases.text: a b · past c d · p.p. e f · a (x y; z)

cases._why: groups spread over lines
cases.html: a b · past c d · p.p. e f · g
cases.text: a b · past c d · p.p. e f · g

cases._why: a base word and the phrase it makes, in single quotes
cases.html: · فکر fekr ‘to think’
cases.text: · فکر fekr ‘to think’

cases._why: the third braces missing: the phrase is recovered up to the semicolon
cases.html: · فکر fekr ‘to think’; x y z
cases.text: · فکر fekr ‘to think’; x y z

cases._why: ...or to the end of the line
cases.html: · فکر fekr ‘to think’
cases.text: · فکر fekr ‘to think’

cases._why: text before and after a \bw
cases.html: a · b c ‘d’ e
cases.text: a · b c ‘d’ e

cases._why: a macro inside the phrase of a \bw
cases.html: · a b ‘c d’
cases.text: · a b ‘c d’

cases._why: a \pw among the prose
cases.voc: \dw{تر}{tar} wet; \dw{خشک}{xošk} dry; \pw{تر و خشک} the good and the bad alike
runs: the good and the bad alike
cases.html: تر tar wet; خشک xošk dry; تر و خشک the good and the bad alike
cases.text: تر tar wet; خشک xošk dry; تر و خشک the good and the bad alike

cases._why: \nobreak dropped, \, a thin space, \textit in italics
cases.html: جا jā place, + ezafe -ye
cases.text: جا jā place, + ezafe -ye

cases._why: \emph and \textit alike
cases.html: sic and sic
cases.text: sic and sic

cases._why: \emph{ alone makes a macro line
cases.html: sic
cases.text: sic

cases._why: \textit{ alone makes a macro line
cases.html: sic
cases.text: sic

cases._why: two words side by side are two words: the join rule puts a space between them
cases.html: <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi> <bdi lang="it" dir="ltr" class="v">b</bdi>
cases.text: a b

cases._why: the join rule: no space before , ; ) . : / nor after ( ‘ /
cases.html: aux. <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi>: yes (<bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">b</bdi>) ‘<bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">c</bdi>’ <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">d</bdi>, <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">e</bdi>; <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">f</bdi>.
cases.text: aux. a: yes (b) ‘c’ d, e; f.

cases._why: an unknown control word is dropped and its braces are text; no macro, so a plain line
cases.html: {x} y
cases.text: {x} y

cases._why: ...and the same beside a macro
cases.html: <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi> {x} y
cases.text: a {x} y

cases._why: render drops \% \& \# \_ \\ with their character; flatten un-escapes the first four first
cases.html: <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi> 50 and 5 3 ab c
cases.text: a 50% and 5& 3# a_b c

cases._why: flatten turns ~ into a space and -- and --- into dashes; render leaves them
cases.html: <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi> b ~ c -- d --- e
cases.text: a b c – d — e

cases._why: a lone backslash at the very end
cases.html: <bdi lang="en" dir="ltr" class="v">a</bdi>
cases.text: a

cases._why: a brace never closed
a group missing
no braces at all
a \bw with only two groups and nothing after them
a macro at the very end of the line
an unclosed macro inside a meaning
a \vb short of its seven
